subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “In science class, students learned that old satellites and broken parts can remain in orbit around Earth.”?
options: The panels changed the roof from an empty surface into a lesson.
A news website changed its comment rules.
The lesson changed their view of exploration.
The lesson changed how students saw archaeology.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The panels changed the roof from an empty surface into a lesson.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A news website changed its comment rules.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The lesson changed their view of exploration.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The lesson changed how students saw archaeology.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The lesson changed their view of exploration.」，答案為「The lesson changed their view of exploration.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The lesson changed their view of exploration.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
